summary: Weibo Corporation filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation transaction. It reports net revenues of US$453.8 million, operating income of US$118.9 million, net income attributable to shareholders of US$67.4 million, and diluted EPS of US$0.26. User metrics show 561 million MAUs and 254 million DAUs. This is a routine earnings release under Rule 13a-16, with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate action. The role is filer, and no deal terms are applicable.
